cluster_name: Mexican influencer César Gastélum shot dead during live stream
event_summary: Mexican content creator César Gastélum was fatally shot during a live stream while working as a food delivery driver; President Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed that authorities are investigating to identify those responsible.
tldr: The cluster's dominant thread is the murder of Mexican influencer César Gastélum, which travelled across borders: Mexico's business press treated it as a crime story while Colombia's El Tiempo amplified the grief of the creator community. The most striking secondary thread is the SpaceX Falcon 9 upper-stage Moon impact, where Spain's Conservative ABC.es and Centre-left El País converge on near-identical scientific-significance framing — a rare left-right lockstep that illustrates how space science escapes editorial tribalism. Argentina's Milei government losing its flagship land-reform chapter appears exclusively in La Nación AR and is invisible to every other Spanish-language outlet in the cluster. A Mexico-US cyclosporiasis surveillance story surfaced by El Sol de México is likewise absent from the regional press, pointing to the uneven diffusion of public-health alerts through Spanish-language media networks.

bottom_line: The murder of Mexican influencer César Gastélum during a live stream is the event pulling cross-border Latin American attention, with grief spreading faster through creator networks than institutional crime coverage.
